mentions.name: ps1-bare-metal
mentions.description: This repository provides a PlayStation 1 bare-metal programming tutorial, including examples, headers, CMake build scripts and tools, and is used by other PS1 homebrew projects as a dependency. It is being overhauled, with plans to split the examples from the core and add examples for SPU sound playback, CD-ROM drive access, and possibly I/O on PS1-based arcade systems.
mentions.problem: The repo was never meant to be an SDK, but it effectively became one that PS1 homebrew projects pull as a submodule and depend on, prompting a planned split between the examples and the core, plus requests for additional examples.
mentions.source_excerpt: An overhaul of my original PlayStation bare-metal programming tutorial repo: https://github.com/spicyjpeg/ps1-bare-metal
